name: Wall of Fire
says: A wall (60-ft line or 20-ft ring) on a solid surface for up to 1 minute of concentration: creatures in it make a Dexterity save at the cast for 5d8 fire (+1d8 per slot above 4th), half on a pass; the chosen side burns creatures that end their turn within 10 ft of it or inside, and a creature entering it or ending its turn there takes the same damage; opaque.
does: On a map the cast lays the wall as a zone from the origin, direction, length and chosen side; creatures inside make the save for 5d8 to 10d8 fire (half on a pass); later hits (entering, ending a turn inside or within 10 ft of the damaging side) deal the damage with no save, once per turn for each cause; it ends with the concentration or after 10 rounds and blocks sight on fog maps (RN-37). Without a map point (no map, or a cast with no origin) it falls back to a one-off save and damage on the listed targets.
seen: The zone on the map with log lines for each save and hit, the master's zone card, and the cast sheet step that asks where the wall lies
